# NullPointerException

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" /> <Badge type="warning" text="experimental" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `NullPointerExceptionInspection`

A value that may be `null` (nullable object parameter, nullable local
variable, call declared to return `?T`/`void`) is dereferenced — property or
method access, array access, invocation, `clone`, or passed to a parameter
that rejects null — without a preceding null check. At runtime this is an
"call to a member function on null"-style error.

Disabled by default (experimental upstream).

## Example

```php{9,10,16,17,30,35,36,50,51,57,60,62,70}
<?php
class Node
{
    public $value;
    public function next(): ?Node { return null; }
    public function take(Node $n) {}
    public function walk(?Node $head, Node $tail = null, ?int $count = null, Node $plain, $loose = null)
    {
        $head->value = 1;
        $head();
        if ($head === null) {
            return;
        }
        $head->value = 2;

        $x = clone $tail;
        $this->take($tail);
        echo $tail->value ?? 'none';
        if (isset($tail->value['a'])) {}
        if ($tail) {
            $tail->value = 3;
        }
        $plain->value = 4;
        $loose->value = 5;
        $count++;
    }

    public function chain()
    {
        $this->next()->next();
        if ($this->next() != null) {
            $this->next()->next();
        }
        $n = $this->next();
        $n->next();
        $n['k'];
        $n = new Node();
        $n->value = 0;

        /** @var Node $m */
        $m = $this->next();
        $m->value = 1;

        $cursor = $this->next();
        while ($cursor !== null) {
            $cursor = $cursor->next();
        }

        $probe = $this->next();
        $probe->value = 1;
        $probe = $probe->next();
    }

    public function refill(Node $left = null, ?Node $right, Node $up = null)
    {
        $left = $left ?: null;
        $left->value = 1;

        $right = $right ?? null;
        $right->next();

        $up = $up->next();
    }

    /** @param Node[] $list */
    public function rewind(array $list)
    {
        foreach ($list as $item) {
            $item = $item->next();      // declaring statement of local $item: right side exempt (E4)
            $item->value = 1;
        }
    }

    public function guarded(?Node $a, ?Node $b, ?Node $c)
    {
        static::assertNotNull($a);
        Verify::that($b)->isObject()->notNull();
        $this->that($c)->notNull();

        return [$a->value, $b->value, $c->value];
    }
}

function visit(?Node $item) {
    \Assert\Assertion::notNull($item);
    return $item->value;
}
```

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "NullPointerException": {
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore NullPointerException

/**
 * @noinspection NullPointerExceptionInspection
 */
```
